# BlackTribe Fashion

> BlackTribe Fashion is a unisex premium streetwear and luxury fashion label from Lagos, Nigeria. It grew out of Black Tribe, a Lagos community of art shows and parties founded in 2017; the fashion arm launched in 2021. Collections are made in limited runs, sold by pre-order, and shipped worldwide. Tagline: Redefining Luxury.

Key facts:

- Founded: 2017 in Lagos, Nigeria (as Black Tribe, a creative community and events brand). Fashion label launched 2021.
- CEO: Daniel Blaq, CEO of Black Tribe Lifestyle.
- What it makes: unisex streetwear and luxury pieces, including crystal-embellished jackets, denim, knitwear, tees, caps and accessories.
- How it sells: limited drops, pre-order only, no restocks and no sale section.
- Where: born in Lagos; the community reaches Portugal, Germany, the UK, Turkey, Paris and beyond. Ships worldwide.
- Prices: in Nigerian Naira (₦). Payment at checkout through Paystack.
- Current collection: Alkebulan.
- Related brand: Black Tribe Lifestyle (events and nightlife).
